This is a list of players in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], by event, from 2022 to 2026. A number is the player's finishing place where the event's final standings were posted as text; X means the player took part but no text standings exist. A blank cell means no record of the player in that event. Total is the number of events played. ROCS is the [[Retro Online Championship Series]]; 2024 ROCS lists the eight seeds.

Participant lists and their sources are on each season article: [[2022 Retro League|2022]] · [[2023 Retro League|2023]] · [[2024 Retro League|2024]] · [[2025 Retro League|2025]] · [[2026 Retro League|2026]].
